cmath_10098.hint:
## technique
- concept: Polynomial Reconstruction from Roots
  description: Determine a polynomial uniquely given its roots, degree, and leading coefficient.
  parameters:
    - roots (type: list[float]): the set of values where the polynomial equals zero
    - leading_coefficient (type: str): the coefficient of the highest degree term
    - degree (type: int): the maximum power of x in the polynomial
  cues:
    - all roots of the polynomial are known
    - degree and leading coefficient of the polynomial are known
  implementation:
    - write P(x) = leading_coefficient * product(x - root for root in roots)
    - verify degree matches the number of roots plus any multiplicity

## theorem
- concept: Factor Theorem
  description: A polynomial P(x) has a root r if and only if (x - r) is a factor of P(x).
  parameters:
    - polynomial (type: str): the polynomial expression being analyzed
    - root (type: float): the value r such that P(r) = 0
  cues:
    - polynomial evaluates to zero at specific input values
    - problem involves finding factors of a polynomial
  implementation:
    - if P(r) = 0, then (x - r) divides P(x)
    - use known roots to write linear factors of the polynomial
